text: PART 1: SECTION (1) - GENERAL
THE ANTIQUITIES ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 188)
Notice under Section 19

I, Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, Minister of Education do hereby give notice that I intend to make an Order under section 18 of theAntiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188) declaring the Monuments specified in the schedule to this Notice, to be ''protectedMounuments'' for the purpose of the aforesaid Ordinance.
Objections to the making of the aforesaid Order shall be forwarded to the Director General of Archaelogy, COlombo on orbefore 07.04.2017.
Every such objection shall be in writing and shall contain a statement of the grounds upon which such objection is made.
AKILA VIRAJ KARIYAWASAM,
Minister of Education.
Colombo,08th March, 2017.
